description: Defines the DataObjects_Affiliates class for managing affiliate data in the Revive Adserver project, including database interactions, account management, and duplication logic.

classes.name: DataObjects_Affiliates
classes.description: Represents the affiliates table with methods for CRUD operations, account handling, duplication, and audit data.

methods.name: staticGet
methods.description: Retrieves a static instance of the affiliate object based on key-value pair.

methods.name: _auditEnabled
methods.description: Indicates audit logging is enabled for this object.

methods.name: _getContextId
methods.description: Returns the context ID, which is the affiliate ID.

methods.name: getOwningManagerId
methods.description: Returns the account ID of the manager owning this affiliate, or admin account ID if not found.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Creates a new affiliate record, associated account, and user if specified.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the affiliate record and associated user and account data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the affiliate record and associated account.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Duplicates the affiliate, including zones, with a new name.

methods.name: _buildAuditArray
methods.description: Builds an audit array with the affiliate's name.
